versions.changelog:
Huawei Cloud MaaS Model Guidance skill - Initial Version 1.0.0

- Provides comprehensive step-by-step guidance for invoking AI models on Huawei Cloud MaaS.
- Covers model selection, multi-language code examples, API Key management, and integration with popular development tools.
- Supports customer workflows for model invocation, permission troubleshooting, and practical scenario guidance.
- Explains differences between API interface types (MaaS Standard, OpenAI Compatible, Anthropic Compatible).
- Lists triggers to respond to common user intents, including text/image generation, embedding, and integration questions.
